instruction: Configure Ubuntu to show the battery percentage in the top system bar.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling battery percentage display in Ubuntu's system bar. The config disables it first (sets to false), and the evaluator checks that the agent enabled it (changed to true). Uses standard GNOME interface schema.
